extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: class C motorhome with over-cab alcove, approx. 7.3 x 2.6 x 3.6 m (L x W x H incl. mirrors and roof unit), wheel diameter 0.80 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; 4 wheels are separate objects with origin on the axle (rotate around local X to roll), rear wheels are twin tyres; hollow cab and living box with translucent windows: seats, steering wheel, dinette with table, kitchen block and the alcove bed are visible inside; entrance door on the right is modelled closed; no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
